description: Self-contained: build yeast presequence vs cytosolic N-terminal feature sets from UniProt, cross-validated logistic classifier, score Mis1 and Ade3, AlphaFold pLDDT of Mis1 N-terminus, summary figure
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_predict, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

def uniprot_search(query, fields="accession,id,sequence,ft_transit", size=500, maxrec=2000):
    out=[]; r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
                           params={"query":query,"fields":fields,"size":size,"format":"json"},timeout=120)
    r.raise_for_status()
    while True:
        out.extend(r.json().get("results",[]))
        nxt=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if not nxt or len(out)>=maxrec: break
        r=requests.get(nxt,timeout=120); r.raise_for_status()
    return out

pos=uniprot_search('(organism_id:559292) AND (reviewed:true) AND (ft_transit:*)')
neg=uniprot_search('(organism_id:559292) AND (reviewed:true) AND (cc_scl_term:SL-0091) NOT (ft_transit:*)')

EIS=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,
         L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
def mu_h(s,w=18,angle=100.0):
    best=0.0;bw=None
    for i in range(0,max(1,len(s)-w+1)):
        x=s[i:i+w]
        if len(x)<w: continue
        ang=np.deg2rad(angle*np.arange(len(x)))
        h=np.array([EIS.get(c,0.) for c in x])
        m=np.hypot((h*np.cos(ang)).sum(),(h*np.sin(ang)).sum())/len(x)
        if m>best: best,bw=m,(i+1,i+w)
    return best,bw
def feats(seq,n=34):
    s=seq[:n]; R=s.count("R");K=s.count("K");D=s.count("D");E=s.count("E")
    m,bw=mu_h(s)
    return dict(Arg=R,Lys=K,Asp=D,Glu=E,net_charge=R+K-D-E,acidic=D+E,
                ST_frac=(s.count("S")+s.count("T"))/len(s),RK_frac=(R+K)/len(s),
                hyd_mean=float(np.mean([EIS.get(c,0.) for c in s])),muH=m,muH_window=str(bw))
def build(recs,label):
    rows=[]
    for rc in recs:
        sq=rc["sequence"]["value"]
        if len(sq)<40: continue
        f=feats(sq); f.update(acc=rc["primaryAccession"],id=rc.get("uniProtkbId"),set=label); rows.append(f)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
dpos=build(pos,"mito presequence"); dneg=build(neg,"cytosolic")
print(f"reference sets: {len(dpos)} annotated mitochondrial presequences, {len(dneg)} cytosolic proteins without one")

MIS1_N="MLSRLSLLSNSRAFQQARWRIYRLKVSPTVHASQ"
ADE3_N="MAGQVLDGKACAQQFRSNIANEIKSIQGHVPGFAPNLAIIQVG"
fm=feats(MIS1_N); fa=feats(ADE3_N)
print("\n### N-terminal 34 residues")
print(pd.DataFrame([dict(protein="Mis1",**{k:v for k,v in fm.items()}),
                    dict(protein="Ade3",**{k:v for k,v in fa.items()})])
      [["protein","Arg","Lys","Asp","Glu","net_charge","acidic","RK_frac","ST_frac","muH","muH_window"]]
      .round(3).to_string(index=False))

print("\n### Feature discrimination and query percentiles")
rows=[]
for v in ["net_charge","acidic","RK_frac","ST_frac","muH"]:
    u,p=mannwhitneyu(dpos[v],dneg[v]); A=u/(len(dpos)*len(dneg))
    rows.append(dict(feature=v,AUC_pre_vs_cyto=round(A,3),p=f"{p:.2g}",
                     Mis1=round(fm[v],3), Mis1_pct_in_presequences=round(100*(dpos[v]<fm[v]).mean(),1),
                     Ade3=round(fa[v],3), Ade3_pct_in_presequences=round(100*(dpos[v]<fa[v]).mean(),1)))
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(tab.to_string(index=False))

FEATS=["net_charge","acidic","RK_frac","ST_frac","muH","hyd_mean"]
X=pd.concat([dpos[FEATS],dneg[FEATS]]).values; y=np.r_[np.ones(len(dpos)),np.zeros(len(dneg))]
clf=make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000,class_weight="balanced"))
prob_cv=cross_val_predict(clf,X,y,cv=StratifiedKFold(10,shuffle=True,random_state=0),method="predict_proba")[:,1]
auc=roc_auc_score(y,prob_cv); clf.fit(X,y)
qp=clf.predict_proba(np.array([[fm[k] for k in FEATS],[fa[k] for k in FEATS]]))[:,1]
print(f"\n10-fold CV AUC (presequence vs cytosolic N-terminus) = {auc:.3f}")
print(f"Mis1 1-34 presequence probability = {qp[0]:.3f}")
print(f"Ade3 1-34 presequence probability = {qp[1]:.3f}")
print(f"Fraction of true presequences scoring below Mis1: {100*(prob_cv[y==1]<qp[0]).mean():.1f}%")
print(f"Fraction of cytosolic N-termini scoring above Ade3: {100*(prob_cv[y==0]>qp[1]).mean():.1f}%")

plddt=None
try:
    meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/P09440",timeout=60).json()
    pdb=requests.get(meta[0]["pdbUrl"],timeout=180).text
    vals={int(l[22:26]):float(l[60:66]) for l in pdb.split("\n")
          if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"}
    plddt=pd.Series(vals).sort_index()
    print(f"\nAlphaFold P09440 pLDDT: mean(1-34)={plddt.loc[1:34].mean():.1f}, mean(35-975)={plddt.loc[35:].mean():.1f}")
    print(f"  fraction pLDDT<70: residues 1-34 = {(plddt.loc[1:34]<70).mean():.2f}, residues 35-975 = {(plddt.loc[35:]<70).mean():.2f}")
except Exception as e:
    print("AlphaFold fetch failed:",repr(e))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16.5,4.7))
ax=axes[0]
ax.scatter(dneg["net_charge"],dneg["muH"],s=24,c="#9aa5b1",alpha=.85,label=f"cytosolic, no presequence (n={len(dneg)})")
ax.scatter(dpos["net_charge"],dpos["muH"],s=24,c="#4c8dbd",alpha=.55,label=f"annotated mito presequence (n={len(dpos)})")
ax.scatter([fm["net_charge"]],[fm["muH"]],s=260,marker="*",c="#d1495b",edgecolor="k",zorder=5,label="Mis1 1-34")
ax.scatter([fa["net_charge"]],[fa["muH"]],s=150,marker="D",c="#edae49",edgecolor="k",zorder=5,label="Ade3 1-34")
ax.set_xlabel("net charge of residues 1-34 (R+K-D-E)")
ax.set_ylabel("max hydrophobic moment, 18-residue window")
ax.set_title("Yeast N-terminal feature space"); ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="upper left")
ax=axes[1]
bins=np.linspace(0,1,26)
ax.hist(prob_cv[y==0],bins=bins,color="#9aa5b1",alpha=.9,label="cytosolic")
ax.hist(prob_cv[y==1],bins=bins,color="#4c8dbd",alpha=.6,label="mito presequence")
ax.axvline(qp[0],color="#d1495b",lw=2.5,label=f"Mis1 = {qp[0]:.2f}")
ax.axvline(qp[1],color="#edae49",lw=2.5,ls="--",label=f"Ade3 = {qp[1]:.2f}")
ax.set_xlabel("presequence probability (10-fold CV)"); ax.set_ylabel("proteins")
ax.set_title(f"Classifier separation, AUC = {auc:.3f}"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax=axes[2]
if plddt is not None:
    ax.plot(plddt.index[:200],plddt.values[:200],lw=1.3,color="#2f4858")
    ax.axvspan(1,34,color="#d1495b",alpha=.18); ax.axhline(70,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1)
    ax.text(4,18,"UniProt transit\npeptide 1-34",fontsize=8,color="#d1495b")
    ax.set_xlabel("Mis1 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
    ax.set_title("Mis1 N-terminus predicted disordered")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
